Unfortunately, once an order has shipped, we're no longer able to change the delivery address on our end. Per our [Shipping Policy (kb/02-shipping-policy.md)](kb/02-shipping-policy.md), address changes are only possible **before** the order ships. After shipment, you'll need to **contact the carrier directly** to request an address update or redirect.

Here's how to get started:
- **Check your shipping confirmation email** for the carrier name (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS) and your tracking number.
- Visit the carrier's website or call their customer service to request an address change or delivery redirect. Note that carriers may charge a fee for this service.

If you run into any trouble, feel free to reach back out and we'll do our best to help!
